title: Ben Sira
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: Poetic book of guidance for living a wise and ethical life, composed in the second century BCE Complete Second Temple text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Second Temple literature includes the Apocrypha and the works of Philo and Josephus, surviving mostly in Greek, Latin and other translations. Its texts are evidence for Jewish thought and practice in the period, not a later rabbinic canon.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
